text: opencode-usage 是面向 DSH Web 的 OpenCode Go 额度徽章插件，会在对话输入区的 composer dock 展示滚动、周和月三个用量窗口、百分比与重置倒计时。主机端注册同源额度接口，浏览器端读取并呈现数据，支持点击名称手动刷新和每五分钟自动刷新，也显示更新时间、加载状态及错误提示。适合希望在 DSH 会话中快速查看 OpenCode Go 订阅额度的人。使用前需配置 OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY，并由 credentials 服务提供；额度数据从 opencode.ai 获取。

opencode-usage shows OpenCode Go rolling, weekly, and monthly quota percentages and reset times in the DSH Web composer. Click to refresh, or let it update every five minutes. It also shows loading and error states. Configure OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY through credentials; data comes from opencode.ai.
想在 DSH Web 对话框里随时看 OpenCode Go 还剩多少额度。
有没有办法同时查看滚动、每周和每月的模型用量？
让 DSH 输入区显示订阅额度百分比和重置倒计时。
我想点一下就刷新 OpenCode Go 的额度状态。
DSH 能不能定时更新 OpenCode Go 的使用额度？
想在聊天页面看到额度更新时间和获取失败提示。
Show my rolling, weekly, and monthly OpenCode Go usage inside the DSH web composer.
I want a DSH badge that refreshes my OpenCode Go quota automatically.
opencode-usage 的功能「额度窗口徽章」：在对话输入区并排显示滚动、周和月额度的百分比，并按使用比例着色，同时给出各窗口的重置倒计时。
opencode-usage 的功能「自动与手动刷新」：徽章加载时立即获取额度，之后每五分钟自动刷新；点击 OpenCode Go 标题也会发起一次刷新。
opencode-usage 的功能「额度接口与状态反馈」：主机端提供同源额度路由，读取滚动、周、月用量并返回重置信息；界面显示加载、更新时间或获取错误。
opencode-usage 需配置 OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY，并向 opencode.ai 请求额度数据；无凭据时返回 no-key。（见 lib/index.js:12-18）

opencode-usage README · opencode-usage：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

OpenCode Go quota badge plugin (bundle) — shows rolling / weekly / monthly quota usage and reset times for OpenCode Go right in the dsh Web UI.

opencode-usage README · Features：- Renders the three quota windows (rolling / weekly / monthly) as colored percentages (green → amber → red by usage) with reset countdowns in the composer dock
- Shows the last fetch time ("updated M/D HH:mm"), switching to "updating…" while a refresh is in flight
- Click the "OpenCode Go" label to refresh the quota manually
- Auto-refreshes every 5 minutes
- The API key lives only inside the harness process: resolved per request through the credentials service, passed to curl via an environment variable, never serialized to the browser or logs

opencode-usage README · Install：This package follows the official [dsh bundle](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) format: it ships prebuilt artifacts (`lib/` is committed to the repo) and has no install scripts, so a git install needs **no** pnpm `allowBuilds` grant.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:AmaTsumeAkira/opencode-usage
```

Or install from a local directory:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add ./opencode-usage
```

Uninstall:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove opencode-usage
```

opencode-usage README · Credentials：The plugin reads `OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY` through the official credentials service (either the environment or `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`):

```yaml

opencode-usage README · ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml：OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY: your-opencode-go-api-key
```

Without a configured key the badge shows "获取失败" (fetch failed).
